seeds.description: no files reached spider complexity — COULD they?

content.IS?: Could any file become a spider (multi-module, typed, tested)?
content.hypothesis: Files at millipede stage with high import count are closest
content.test: Find millipede files with ≥5 imports and ≥3 functions
content.if_false: spider remains COULD — the organism isn't complex enough yet

seeds.description: all files pre-fold — the organism hasn't inverted

content.IS?: Could any file exist past 90° on the torus?
content.hypothesis: Files that are BOTH far from core AND net producers fold past π/2
content.test: Find files where distance > π AND direction < 0 (net producer from edge)
content.if_false: fold remains MIGHT — all production comes from inside

seeds.description: no directories under pressure — too comfortable?

content.IS?: Are any directories actually under pressure?
content.hypothesis: Directories with high churn + high import count + recent changes
content.if_true: pressure=MIGHTN'T → pressure=IS — we weren't looking hard enough
content.if_false: pressure remains MIGHTN'T — the organism genuinely has no bottleneck

seeds.description: bitter nearly zero — the organism can't taste toxin

content.IS?: Is there actually toxin the organism can't taste?
content.hypothesis: Orphan directories (triage lost=4088) are untasted bitter
content.test: Sample 10 orphan dirs — are they dead weight or dormant value?
content.if_true: bitter flips from SHAN'T to IS — we found the toxin
content.if_false: orphans are fossils, not toxins — correctly SHAN'T

content.IS?: Can the Klein fold run itself?
content.hypothesis: A cron job every 30 min would make 1 self-spinning plate
content.test: Deploy klein-evolve.sh to cron, run 24h, count autonomous folds
content.if_true: self_spin goes 0 → 1. The plate spins on its own.
content.if_false: cron fails or produces no new data — the motor doesn't work

polymerase_summary.fold_is_pcr: each Klein fold IS a PCR cycle
